text:
Situation: Valacyclovir hydrochloride 1 g tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale General holds 256 tablets, providing 16.4 days of supply at the current burn rate of 15.6 tablets per day.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list does not include valacyclovir hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21. The current repack plant for NDC 51655070304 is Northwind Health Company, LLC (FEI 1831143), which received a VAI classification on 2025-09-26 (inspection 1256379) and an OAI classification on 2015-12-09 (inspection 952157). Aurobindo Pharma Limited, the top-ranked buying option, is not on the shortage list. Its plants show: APL HEALTHCARE LIMITED (VAI 2025-12-17), Aurobindo Pharma Limited (VAI 2022-05-10), and Aurolife Pharma LLC (OAI 2021-12-07). Alternative manufacturers AvPAK, Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Chartwell RX, LLC, and Coupler LLC are also not on the shortage list, but their labels name no identifiable plant.

Our position: Current inventory is low but the drug is not in a nationally recognized shortage. Procurement should prioritize suppliers with transparent, recently inspected manufacturing sites.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places purchase order with Aurobindo Pharma Limited; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer qualifies AvPAK as a secondary source pending plant identification; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer qualifies Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as a tertiary source pending plant identification; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer monitors FDA shortage list weekly and reports changes to P&T Committee; requires Buyer compliance.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative antiviral agents or adjusting clinical protocols based on supply status alone.
